title: I Put the Missing-Package Photo on the Lobby Board They Moderated

parts.text: I taped a photo of my empty lobby cubby at 6:22 p.m. under the heading the board allowed: lost items. The moderator, who also sits on the condo board, had removed my last two posts about missing boxes as off-topic. I was thirty-five, holding a tracking page that said delivered to mailroom. The photo showed the cubby and the time. I did not accuse a name. Within twenty minutes a neighbor returned a box that had been in their stroller by mistake, they said. The moderator left the photo up because lost items was his category. I opened a kettle. The tracking page finally matched a kitchen. Off-topic is a mood. Lost is a cubby. I will use the heading they wrote until the mailroom grows a door that closes.

social.video_title: Lost items was their heading, so the cubby stayed — Part 1/1
social.description: Removed posts, allowed board, stroller box. Delivered finally meant me. Would you have named someone?
